name: function-usage-detector
description: Generate JSON and HTML reports for short or rarely called functions

scripts.test: pnpm test:fixtures && pnpm test:report && pnpm test:workflow
scripts.test:fixtures: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/codemod.ts
scripts.test:workflow: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 workflow run -w workflow.yaml -t tests/workspace-smoke --allow-dirty --no-interactive --param report_directory=.codemod-reports/workflow-test && node scripts/verify-workflow-report.mjs
scripts.validate: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 workflow validate -w workflow.yaml
scripts.validate-package:ai: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 ai call validate_codemod_package --input '{"package_path":"."}'
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm check-types && pnpm validate
